name: beyond_list_documents
description: List or read shared project documents from TB_DOCUMENT, such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, README.md, business_requirements.md, and test_scenario.md. Returns working-stage documents only.

limit.description: Maximum number of documents to fetch, newest updated first.

include_content.description: When false, return document metadata without DOC_CONTENT.

file_name.description: Optional exact file name filter, such as README.md.

include_json_content.description: When false, omit duplicated JSON from text content and rely on structuredContent.
